Methods take positional ids, then one params object whose path ids (`zone_id`, `account_id`) the library takes for the path and whose other keys are the body or query: `dns.records.create({ zone_id, type, name })` posts `{ type, name }` to `/zones/{zone_id}/dns_records`. 7.x moved the first positional id of some methods into the params object (`kv.namespaces.values.get(key, { account_id, namespace_id })` for `get(namespaceId, key, { account_id })`): `idInParams` reads both. Workers AI's `ai.run(model, { account_id, ...input })` (3.x `workers.ai.run`) carries the model in the path. Covered resources: zones, DNS records, Workers scripts and routes, KV, R2 buckets, Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize, D1, cache purge, Pages projects, Queues, Images, Stream, custom hostnames, Turnstile, accounts and user tokens; the other resources and the methods that pick `accounts` or `zones` by the id given (email routing rules in 7.x) are not. 2.x (`require("cloudflare")({ token })`, `cf.dnsRecords.add(zoneId, record)`): positional ids, then the body (the query of a GET).
